verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge without a native automation engine. Automations count only if they are stored as code in a repository, where they get Git versioning and commit history [30, 1], pull-request review with diffs and stacks [2, 3], and rulesets that require reviews, CODEOWNERS approval and passing checks [19, 21]. Its only automation-like hooks, webhooks and Buildkite checks [16, 17], are not shown to be versioned or reversible themselves. missing for 10: a first-party automation/workflow feature, documented versioning of webhook or CI configuration, an explicit rollback or revert capability beyond plain Git history, and independent corroboration.
